jobs.title: Analyst, State Dispute Operations
jobs.description:
About Pivotal Health

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, they’re often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement they’re entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. We’re building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About The Role

We’re looking for a State Dispute Analyst to handle the day-to-day filing and tracking of Pivotal’s state-level healthcare reimbursement disputes. You’ll prepare and submit disputes through state portals, agencies and arbitration entities. You’ll track deadlines and fees while ensuring accurate case records from filing through resolution.

Each state runs its process differently, with its own deadlines, forms, fees and submission rules. You’ll work from the team’s state-by-state references, follow them closely and flag anything that looks off or has changed. You’ll sit within our dispute operations team while working with our analytics and product teams to keep case data clean.

This is a great fit for someone who is highly detail-oriented, likes fast changing, high-volume work and wants to build expertise in healthcare reimbursement. In this work, one missing detail can delay a provider’s payment.

What You’ll Do

Prepare and submit filings: Enter and submit state dispute and arbitration requests through state portals, agencies and arbitration entities, following each state’s documentation and formatting requirements.
Track deadlines, fees and payments: Monitor filing and response deadlines, process fees and confirm payers pay awarded amounts. Follow up when a payment is late or incorrect.
Manage inbox and correspondence: Monitor shared inboxes, respond to payers, state agencies and arbitration entities, and log next steps for each case.
Keep case records accurate: Update internal systems and spreadsheets with case details and statuses, and close disputes only once they’re fully resolved.
Follow state requirements: Work from state references for eligibility, deadlines, forms and fees, and flag rule changes or gaps so the references stay current.
Flag data issues: Tell our analytics and product teams when a case file is incomplete or inaccurate.

Who You Are

2–4 years of experience in data management, operational tracking, revenue cycle operations, claims management, or insurance operations
Experience with medical billing or coding, and comfortable reading EOBs, claims and reimbursement codes
Comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets, including pivot tables
Highly detail-oriented, and catches inconsistencies in documents and data
Manages high volume and competing deadlines accurately
Comfortable following detailed, state-specific processes
Clear written communicator who asks good questions and flags problems early

Extra Credit
Experience

Familiarity with the federal No Surprises Act and how it interacts with state surprise billing laws
Prior experience with state arbitration programs (e.g., New York, New Jersey, Texas)
Experience with tools like Asana or Metabase or other project management tools
Medical billing/coding certification (e.g., CPC)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

We’re a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. While we primarily hire around our core hubs–Los Angeles and New York–we remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.

If you’re excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, we’d love to hear from you .

Benefits Include:

Competitive compensation, including equity
Full health, dental, and vision coverage
Retirement savings plan through 401(k)
Flexible time off
Opportunities for company-wide connection and events

Ready to Make an Impact?

We’re building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.

Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and let’s transform healthcare reimbursement together .

Work Authorization

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

Pivotal Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Pivotal Health provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you need assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Amex Offers & Digital Media (AODM) is building an integrated Offers and Ads business designed to strengthen Membership while delivering differentiated value to advertisers. We are seeking a highly strategic and commercially oriented Director of Strategy & GTM Analytics to shape where and how AODM grows. This leader will own the analytics agenda supporting AODM’s most important forward-looking strategic choices; connecting business strategy, commercial economics, growth opportunities, go-to-market intelligence, and AI-enabled transformation.

The Director will serve as a senior thought partner to AODM leadership and cross-functional partners across Product, Sales, GTM, Finance, Analytics, and Technology. The role will frame ambiguous business questions, develop fact-based strategic choices and business cases, evaluate trade-offs, and translate analytical insight into clear recommendations that influence investment, product, pricing, revenue, and GTM decisions.

A critical part of the mandate is incubation: identifying emerging growth opportunities and analytical capabilities, establishing the thesis and evidence required to test them, and determining whether they should scale, stop, or transition to a durable owner. This includes leadership of the AODM AI and advanced analytics agenda; connecting AI investments and emerging analytical capabilities to measurable business, customer, advertiser, and productivity outcomes.

This Director will lead a team spanning complementary areas of Growth Strategy & GTM Analytics and Strategic Analytics, AI & Revenue Strategy, creating a unified strategy organization capable of moving from strategic question to evidence, recommendation, incubation, and ultimately scaled execution.

Build and develop a high-performing strategy and analytics team, strengthening commercial judgment, structured problem solving, analytical rigor, executive communication, and leadership capability.

Job Description

Join Team Amex and let's lead the way together.

Resy is the American Express global dining platform within U.S. Consumer Services (USCS). Our mission is to power the world’s best restaurants, using technology to imagine the future of hospitality. Our customers discover the amazing world of restaurants thanks to our content-rich website and innovative mobile app. Our diners are insiders, and we love having them at the table. The team is responsible for reimagining hospitality and redefining the way restaurants and diners connect through a single network.

Interested in joining our team of restaurant-obsessed explorers? Right this way.   

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior
Analyst, Venue Retention & Lifecycle Marketing
, to support the execution and optimization of Resy’s venue retention, nurture, and B2B content marketing strategy. Reporting to the Manager of Venue Lifecycle and Retention Marketing
, this role will play a key part in bringing data-driven, multi-channel marketing programs to life that deepen restaurant partner engagement, strengthen loyalty, drive product adoption, and support long-term partner retention.

This individual will work closely with the Manager of Venue Retention Marketing to execute partner nurture strategies and B2B content programs across the venue lifecycle
, translating strategic priorities, partner insights, and product value into relevant and compelling communications. They will own key executional workstreams across email and editorial content
including the B2B Content Calendar and end-to-end development of Resy’s partner eNewsletter, while supporting the development and execution of trigger-based and ongoing nurture journeys.

The role will sit at the intersection of lifecycle marketing, B2B content, email execution, and marketing operations
. This person will partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Partner Success, Product, Creative, Compliance, and other teams to move campaigns and initiatives from ideation and briefing through development, approval, deployment, measurement, and optimization. They will bring strong operational rigor to the team, ensuring that multiple campaigns, stakeholders, approvals, and deadlines are effectively managed.

The ideal candidate is an organized and execution-oriented marketer with strong email, editorial, and social instincts and analytical curiosity
. They are equally comfortable developing a content idea, building an email campaign, coordinating a legal review, analyzing campaign performance, and managing a complex project plan. They have a desire to understand our hospitality partners and use data-driven lifecycle marketing to create communications that deliver meaningful value.

Responsibilities

Support the execution and optimization of Resy’s venue retention and lifecycle marketing strategy, bringing partner-facing content and communications to life across email, editorial, and social channels.
Lead execution of partner email and lifecycle programs, including Resy’s partner eNewsletter, developing relevant, engaging communications across key partner moments while evolving and optimizing evergreen engagement strategies.
Manage Resy’s B2B editorial ecosystem, including supporting blog maintenance and owning the content calendar, translating product capabilities, industry trends, partner stories, and business priorities into timely partner-facing content.
Partner with the Manager to advance personalization, segmentation, and ongoing optimization of email and content, using partner insights and performance data to improve the relevance and effectiveness of communications.
Support cross-functional campaign execution, partnering with Sales, Partner Success, Product, Product Marketing, Creative, Compliance, and other stakeholders to keep initiatives aligned and on track.
Support the development of partner retention and loyalty strategies, identifying opportunities to deepen engagement through new channels, programs, events, and partner experiences.
Maintain strong operational processes and project management across campaigns and content, ensuring clear timelines, approvals, documentation, and performance reporting.
Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Partner Success, Product, Product Marketing, Creative, and other teams to ensure partner communications reflect shared business objectives.

Qualifications

new_jobs.description:
About Pivotal Health

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, they’re often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement they’re entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. We’re building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About The Role

We’re looking for a State Dispute Analyst to handle the day-to-day filing and tracking of Pivotal’s state-level healthcare reimbursement disputes. You’ll prepare and submit disputes through state portals, agencies and arbitration entities. You’ll track deadlines and fees while ensuring accurate case records from filing through resolution.

Each state runs its process differently, with its own deadlines, forms, fees and submission rules. You’ll work from the team’s state-by-state references, follow them closely and flag anything that looks off or has changed. You’ll sit within our dispute operations team while working with our analytics and product teams to keep case data clean.

This is a great fit for someone who is highly detail-oriented, likes fast changing, high-volume work and wants to build expertise in healthcare reimbursement. In this work, one missing detail can delay a provider’s payment.

What You’ll Do

Prepare and submit filings: Enter and submit state dispute and arbitration requests through state portals, agencies and arbitration entities, following each state’s documentation and formatting requirements.
Track deadlines, fees and payments: Monitor filing and response deadlines, process fees and confirm payers pay awarded amounts. Follow up when a payment is late or incorrect.
Manage inbox and correspondence: Monitor shared inboxes, respond to payers, state agencies and arbitration entities, and log next steps for each case.
Keep case records accurate: Update internal systems and spreadsheets with case details and statuses, and close disputes only once they’re fully resolved.
Follow state requirements: Work from state references for eligibility, deadlines, forms and fees, and flag rule changes or gaps so the references stay current.
Flag data issues: Tell our analytics and product teams when a case file is incomplete or inaccurate.

Who You Are

2–4 years of experience in data management, operational tracking, revenue cycle operations, claims management, or insurance operations
Experience with medical billing or coding, and comfortable reading EOBs, claims and reimbursement codes
Comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets, including pivot tables
Highly detail-oriented, and catches inconsistencies in documents and data
Manages high volume and competing deadlines accurately
Comfortable following detailed, state-specific processes
Clear written communicator who asks good questions and flags problems early

Extra Credit
Experience

Familiarity with the federal No Surprises Act and how it interacts with state surprise billing laws
Prior experience with state arbitration programs (e.g., New York, New Jersey, Texas)
Experience with tools like Asana or Metabase or other project management tools
Medical billing/coding certification (e.g., CPC)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

We’re a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. While we primarily hire around our core hubs–Los Angeles and New York–we remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.

If you’re excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, we’d love to hear from you .

Full health, dental, and vision coverage
Retirement savings plan through 401(k)
Flexible time off
Opportunities for company-wide connection and events

Ready to Make an Impact?

We’re building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.

Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and let’s transform healthcare reimbursement together .
